Cartographic view override: approximate customer reference reflecting the Russian Federation position; not a map of internationally recognized borders or actual control.

The derived database cartography.json and data/cartographic-regions.geojson are available under ODbL 1.0: https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/ . Geometries have been clipped, buffered and merged for this presentation.
